name: Migle Rakitaite
description:
Miglė is the founder of WinPrivacy, a non-profit community-turned-creative agency working with non-extractive tech companies.  Her mission is to facilitate the bridge between technology and humans through art, culture, and sociology. Migle graduated from Amsterdam University, where she specialized in Media, Culture and Digital Warfare.  
She supports Swarm Foundation as a creative strategist and ecosystem builder, helping to "translate" complex technologies into user cases.
